name: toolchain-smoke-environment
description: Server-managed environments: POST /api/v1/environments registers an env (image.docker for Docker provider; dockerfile field is Daytona-only). BUT 'fabro run --environment <id>' resolves the environment catalog CLIENT-side (seeded catalog + .fabro/project.toml [environments.<slug>] sections) — server-managed envs are only visible to web-UI/server-created runs. For CLI+UI parity define the environment in project.toml AND register it server-side. Validated: fabro run smoke --environment toolchain (run 01M0J3733RGTVD9GKRR8F8WF9G, 5/6 stages green incl. full nextest suite; TS failures preexisting, see fabro-e16c). Image: .fabro/Dockerfile.toolchain -> fabro-toolchain:noble (buildpack-deps:noble base reuses default-env layers).
